digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler backend initialization and scope validation
propositions: _build_datacenter must assert non-secret scope readiness (base_url and project) at build time with typed BackendEnvError, matching _build_cloud's fail-closed placement

assert_datacenter_nonsecret_scope_ready must validate base_url and jira.project only, preserving lazy PAT and network validation in _LazyDataCenterClient so DC backends compose without JIRA_PAT or agents extra
assert_cloud_scope_ready docstring must document email-format JIRA_USER and non-empty project checks as intentional, canonical tightening over legacy ambient assert_env_ready, not accidental drift
JiraBackend.assert_env_ready scope-path note must clarify deliberate stricter validation for Cloud is correct, not a relaxation target
DC build with empty base_url or empty jira.project must raise BackendEnvError at build time; DC build with base_url and project set but no JIRA_PAT must succeed with lazy client
Unit tests must verify both fail-closed paths (empty url/project raises) and lazy-preserved path (no PAT still constructs) without breaking existing reconciler test suites
